review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Role Overview A fully remote telehealth organization is seeking a hands-on, highly organized Senior IT Systems Administrator to own the day-to-day operation of its internal technology environment. This position balances hands-on troubleshooting with building scalable, well-documented systems and repeatable processes. Working in close partnership with the Senior Security Engineer, the role operationalizes day-to-day administrative controls to support organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Security & Compliance Alignment: Operationalize approved identity, access, and endpoint controls; support audit evidence collection, access reviews, and incident escalations; and maintain operational practices supporting HIPAA and healthcare data protection requirements without owning the broader security or compliance program. Qualifications 5 - 8+ years of progressive experience
